claim: The certified lower-bound set for r_3 (max size of a 3-AP-free subset of {1..n}) is not closed under monotonicity, so taking the running maximum strictly improves banked bounds, e.g. r_3(80)>=19 supersedes r_3(80)>=15.

facets.mechanism: monotone closure of a certified bound ledger for an extremal function
facets.method: running-maximum sweep over certified lower bounds indexed by n
facets.outcome: strictly improved lower bounds obtained with no new search
facets.entities: 3-AP-free subsets of the first n integers
